## Project Overview

**Name:** ps2-covers
**Type:** Asset repository — a cover-art collection for PS2 games, plus four Python maintenance scripts
**Description:** PS2 game cover images, served over raw.githubusercontent.com and consumed by the PCSX2 Cover Downloader and by PSCoverDL.
**Package:** not published — the repository *is* the artifact. Consumers fetch a raw file URL by serial.
**Upstream:** forked from `xlenore/ps2-covers`; `origin` is `adambartosiewicz/ps2-covers`.

---

## Critical Constraints

- **A filename is a public API.** Consumers request `covers/default/${serial}.jpg` and `covers/3d/${serial}.png` by exact serial. Renaming, re-casing, or changing the extension of a cover breaks every consumer silently. Never rename a cover to "tidy" it.
- **Extension per directory is fixed.** `covers/default/` is `.jpg`, `covers/3d/` is `.png`. Do not mix them.
- **Default covers are 512×736.** `tools/update_cover_size.py` enforces this and `tools/save_cover.py` writes it. A cover of another size is a defect.
- **`tools/GameIndex.yaml` is vendored from PCSX2.** It is the serial database, ~60k lines. Update it from upstream PCSX2, never by hand-editing single entries.
- **Never commit a cover you did not verify.** A wrong serial ships wrong art to every user of the URL.
- **The scripts touch only this repository.** No script may gain network access, subprocess calls, or a write path outside `covers/` and the two root `.txt` files. This was audited on 2026-09-10; keep it true.

---

## Code Conventions

### Naming
- Cover files: the game serial in upper case, exactly as `GameIndex.yaml` spells it — `SLES-53225.jpg`, `SCAJ-20144.png`.
- Python files: `snake_case.py`. Module-level constants: `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`.

### Python
- Standard library plus four third-party packages: `opencv-python` (`cv2`), `Pillow` (`PIL`), `numpy`, `PyYAML`. There is no `requirements.txt` — add one if you touch dependency setup. <!-- TODO: fill in the intended Python version -->
- Every script resolves its paths from `Path(__file__)` / `os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))`, so it runs from any working directory. Keep that pattern.
- Read YAML with `yaml.safe_load`, never `yaml.load`.
- Each script is a standalone `main()` behind `if __name__ == "__main__":`. There is no shared package and no imports between scripts.

### Testing
- There are no tests and no test runner. A change to a script is verified by running it and looking at the output image or the printed table.

---

## Architecture Decisions

- **The repository ships raw files, not a package.** PCSX2 and PSCoverDL fetch a URL per serial, so directory layout and filenames are the contract. This is why the constraints above are absolute.
- **Two cover formats are kept side by side.** `default` is the flat 2D scan; `3d` is a rendered box. `tools/generic_3d_cover/main.py` generates a 3D cover from a default one, so `3d` may lag behind `default` — that is expected, not a bug.
- **`generic_3d_cover_list.txt` lists machine-generated 3D covers.** Its header says "Just in case someone has a better 3d cover": an entry there is an invitation to replace it with a real scan.
- **`missing_covers.txt` and the README stats table are generated.** `tools/update_stats.py` writes the file and prints the table.

---

## House Rules

- Treat `missing_covers.txt`, `generic_3d_cover_list.txt`, and the README "Covers Stats" table as generated. Change the covers, then re-run `tools/update_stats.py`.
- Treat `tools/generic_3d_cover/generic_3d_cover/` output as scratch. Move an accepted render into `covers/3d/`; do not commit the scratch folder.
- Flag any new Python dependency for approval before you add it.
- Keep the scripts free of network calls and subprocess calls.
- One commit changes covers, or changes scripts — not both.
- `.idea/` is local, not from upstream. Only `.idea/.gitignore` and `.idea/vcs.xml` are shared;
  `.idea/.gitignore` ignores everything else, including `*.iml` and `modules.xml`, because those hold
  machine-specific paths.

## Repository Anatomy

```
covers/
  default/                 ← 10,429 flat covers, .jpg, 512×736, named <SERIAL>.jpg
  3d/                      ← 10,718 rendered box covers, .png, named <SERIAL>.png
tools/
  GameIndex.yaml           ← vendored PCSX2 serial database — the source of truth for serials
  save_cover.py            ← clipboard watcher: image, then serial, writes covers/default/
  update_cover_size.py     ← normalises covers/default/ to 512×736 (edits in place)
  update_stats.py          ← prints the README stats table, writes missing_covers.txt
  generic_3d_cover/
    main.py                ← renders a 3D box cover from a default cover
    ps2-template.png       ← the box template the render warps onto
generic_3d_cover_list.txt  ← serials whose 3D cover is machine-generated
missing_covers.txt         ← generated: serials with no cover yet
```

## Commands Worth Knowing

```bash
python tools/update_cover_size.py     # EDITS covers/default/ IN PLACE and re-encodes at quality 95.
                                      # It prompts once, then rewrites every off-size file. No backup.

python tools/save_cover.py            # Polls your clipboard every 0.5s until Ctrl+C.
                                      # Copy the image first, then copy the serial (must contain "-").

python tools/generic_3d_cover/main.py # Writes to tools/generic_3d_cover/generic_3d_cover/, NOT covers/3d/.
                                      # Skips any serial that already has a 3D cover. Needs the fonts
                                      # YuGothB.ttc and malgun.ttf on the system font path; without them
                                      # it silently falls back to a default bitmap font and the spine
                                      # text renders badly. Both fonts are Windows-only by default.

python tools/update_stats.py          # Prints the stats table to stdout — paste it into README.md by hand.
                                      # Overwrites missing_covers.txt without asking.
```

## Useful Context for AI Agents

- **Consumer URLs:** `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xlenore/ps2-covers/main/covers/default/${serial}.jpg` and `.../covers/3d/${serial}.png`. The README points at upstream, not at this fork.
- **Serial prefixes** encode region and publisher: `SLUS`/`SCUS` NTSC-U, `SLES`/`SCES` PAL, `SLPS`/`SLPM`/`SCPS` NTSC-J, `SLKA`/`SCKA` Korea.
- **`GameIndex.yaml` entry shape:** the serial is the key; `name-en` or `name` holds the title, `region` the region. It also carries PCSX2 gamefixes and memory patches — those are for the emulator and are irrelevant here.
- **Coverage today:** ~10.4k of the indexed serials have a default cover. `missing_covers.txt` is the work queue.
- **Commit convention:** upstream uses plain descriptive subjects (`Improve SLPM-66947 cover quality.`, `Update SCAJ-20144 with correct covers and improved quality`). Name the serial in the subject.
- **PR conventions:** upstream merges contributor pull requests unsquashed. <!-- TODO: fill in what you want for this fork -->
